revisions.acceptanceCriteria: 1. Merge latest origin/main into codex/pr-review-merge-ui without dropping either branch's intended source changes. 2. Resolve .eve history by retaining records from both branches and rebuilding any derived index through eve tooling or deterministic merge. 3. Resolve UI/API/type overlaps so pull-request review, runtime events, and artifact previews all compile and retain their tests. 4. Regenerate embedded UI assets from the resolved source instead of hand-merging hashed bundles. 5. Full Go, UI, npm package, and production build verification passes. 6. PR #36 is pushed with GitHub reporting no merge conflict. 7. Record a fresh eve Snapshot at the resolved head so PR #36 remains in the eve review queue with current context.
